name: Lockstep under a slow server read: the server reads every 20th of alice's command packets 2.5 s late (slowRead, as a loaded machine can) and the run plays exactly as it does without it: she walks 60 ticks and fires, the client's prediction agrees with the server every tick, she ends where the same commands take her (the harness waits for a sent command with a barrier on its socket, never a wall-clock timeout: before, 'command N never arrived' after 2 s)
